tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rta mchog rol pa'i tshogs dkyil gyi 'phrin las bzhugs so//

༄༅// phyag 'tshal 'byung po thams cad 'jigs byed pa// padma gar gyi dbang po'i rta mchog zhal// rdo rje phag mos tsumba na byed cing*// drag po'i rta skad 'tsher 'tsher de la'o// ting 'dzin gsum dang rten dang brten pa bskyed// glu dang mchod bzhi sbyor dang sgrol ba po// rnam par mi rtog ye nas skye med cing*// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i mtha' la ma chags dbyings// thams cad spros bral mnyam nyid ji bzhin dang*// rnam rtog brjod med smra bsam yul las 'das// oṃ mahā shu n+yā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i rtsal chen po// ma ltar byams pa'i snying rjes yongs la khyab// mkha' ltar go 'byed cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i yum// kun khyab ye shes gter bzhin che ba ston// oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ thugs rjes zung 'jug sems kyi rang bzhin te// chags pa'i skyon bral rin chen sna lnga'i mdog /'byung ba lnga dang yum lnga ye shes lnga// gdul bya'i 'phrin las rnam pa lnga ru sbyor// badzra tsitta hūm̐/ gsal ba'i sgo 'byed nam mkhar gyur// dus gsum 'gyur med kun tu bzang*// rgya gram rlung gi dkyil 'khor gsal// thams cad skyed byed dam tshig sgrol// rakta khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil// thams cad sdud pa'i mā ma kī /keng rus chen po'i ri rab ste// ma lus brten pa'i sangs rgyas spyan// bskal pa'i me dpung chen po 'bar// 'byung ba drud snyoms na bza' dkar// bha ga kun kyang nam mkha' mnyam// gzugs khams ma lus dbang sdud phyir// lha chen brgyad ni rmang du btings// 'dod khams ma lus dbang sdud phyir// phyogs skyong bcu ni rtsigs par brtsigs// sku bzhi dpal brgyad tshang pa'i phyir// rgyal chen bzhi ni ka bar btsugs// gti mug ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir// klu chen brgyad ni gdung du bres// gzhal yas ma bsgribs gsal ba'i phyir// gza' chen brgyad ni bad du bor// dus bzhi 'gyur ldog med bya'i phyir// rgyu skar phyogs nas mig tshags byas// rgyal mtshan bzhi dang bla rer bcas// nya sbrul mchog phran za ra tshags// rnam par thar pa bzhir 'jug phyir// sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi yis brgyan/

khams gsum ma lus dbang sdud phyir// dbus su zla gam dbang gi gdan// padma gar gyi dbang po'i sku// rab 'jigs du ba'i mdog 'dra la// 'od zer bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// sa gsum 'byung po brlag par byed// rta rgod mi gzan mche gtsigs zhal// drag po'i rta skad 'tsher 'tsher sgrog /rngog ma ye shes me ru 'bar// phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa// hūm̐ dgu raṃ dgus mtshan pa 'phyar// g.yon pa gnam lcags sdig pa ni/ kha dgu mig dgu ldan pa bsnams// dpal gyi chas bcus brjid par byas// g.yon tu yum chen bā rā hi// mthing nag chen mo gcer bu la// dur phag khros pa'i zhal spyan gdangs// sdigs mdzub phyag rgyas sa 'og gzir// mgo 'phreng sbrul dang thod skam brgyan// gnyis ka'ang g.yon brkyang rol pas ni// nyin mor byed pa'i gdan la bzhugs// chos rgyal mthing nag ma he'i gdong*// thod dbyug 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub mdzad// e ka dza ṭī sngo nag ni// spyan gcig mche gcig snying spyang 'dzin// rā hu la ni dud pa'i mdog /chu srin zhags pa mda' gzhu 'chang*// laṅka mgrin bcu mun pa 'dra// ral gri phyar nas mdung thung 'dzin// bdud rgyal yab rje nag po ste/ khram shing sho rde lag na bsrel// nor bdag ngal gsos bu gser mdog /stag gi rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams// chu bdag chen po ba ru ṇa// rab dkar lag gnyis thal mo sbyar// ma hā de ba dmar po ni// lcags kyu dang ni liṅga'o// kun kyang rang rang sder bcas te// srog snying gad rgyangs chen po ston// sprul pa ci yang bkye nas su// zhi rgyas dbang drag las la sbyor// hūm̐ badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ/ badzra bhe ra ba bā rā hi a ya ma du ru tsa sha na la/ chu las chu bur tshul du ni// gtso 'khor dran rig rdzogs par 'dod// 'di yis mgon po bskul nas ni// dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub// snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyi ni// dpyid kyi rgyal po glur blangs pas// dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yis// gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin// zhes gsungs 'di la'ang tshad ma yin// oṃ/

'khor lo ye shes can rnams kyis// 'khor lo rdo rje bsgoms byas nas// de nyid chos sku nam mkha' che// hoḥ hūm̐/ rdo rje ye shes can rnams ni// rdo rje rdo rje bsgoms byas na// de nyid chos nyid ngang las rdzogs// hoḥ swa/ rin chen ye shes can rnams ni// rin chen rdo rje bsgoms byas na// de nyid longs spyod lhun gyis grub// hoḥ aṃ/ padma ye shes can rnams ni// padma rdo rje bsgoms byas na// de nyid brtan pas 'gyur ba med// hoḥ ha/ rgya gram ye shes can rnams ni// rgya gram rdo rje bsgoms byas na// de nyid sprul sku ngo mtshar che// hoḥ rgyan nyid ye shes glur blangs pas// bskul dang don byas 'dus pa dang*// thams cad a de dngos med sku// stong pa chen po'i ngang la bzhag /hoḥ gang gis kun nas khrag gis mtshan// spos dang me tog dam pa dang*// mar me dri yi rdzas rnams la// de yi mchod pa'i phyag rgya yis// kun tu bsgrims te 'di yis 'bul// oṃ gyi ye shes las byung po// byang chub sems kyi sprin chen las// kun tu mnyam sbyor phyag rgya che// gsang mchog lhun gyis grub pa yi// mchod pa chen po de bzhin gshegs// yo gi nī shwa rā pū dza hūm̐/ de nas gzugs sgra dri ro dang*// reg bya'i lha mo thams cad 'dis// e ma ho mchod pa bla na med// e ma ho mchod pa kun gyi gsang*// e ma ho yang dag mchod pa che// e ma ho mchod pa chags pa che// de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'dis// sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba 'di// sangs rgyas lnga yi dam tshig mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal// rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog /pañtsa pra dī pā bhuñdza tha/ nyis bral bdud rtsi lnga yi chu// rdo rje mchod pa bla na med// zhi ba'i btung ba dam pa 'dis// dngos grub dam pa thob par shog /pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥ de nas gtor ma chen po 'dis// bza' dang bca' ba yang dag nyid/

kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// thams cad sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'di// kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol// a kā ro'i sngags kyis 'bul// de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa 'dis// hrīḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// dpal ldan gar gyi dbang phyug che// shin tu drag cing gzi brjid ldan// kun tu sbyor ba dam pa thob// gzugs phung chos dbyings ye shes che// mig la sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad// rnam gsum gzugs dang rol mdzad de// brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul// tshor ba kun rtog ye shes che// rna ba rdo rje nyi ma yin// rnam gsum sgra dang rol mdzad de// brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul// 'du shes mnyam nyid ye shes che// lce la padma gar dbang rgyal// rnam gsum ro dang rol mdzad de// brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul// 'du byed bya ba grub pa'i las// sna la rta mchog rol pa'i las// rnam gsum dri dang rol mdzad cing*// brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul// rnam shes me long ye shes che// yid la rdo rje he ru ka /rnam gsum chos dang rol mdzad de// brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul// kun khyab stong pa'i ye shes che// lus la rdo rje sems dpa' gnas// rnam gsum reg dang rol mdzad de// brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnam par 'phrul// rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma che// 'jigs rung khros pa'i byed pa yis// bdud dang bdud kyi sde thams cad// rmongs rengs phur bus gdab par mdzad// gshin rje ma mo gza' dang srin// bdud dang klu dang gnod sbyin lha// sder bcas dpal gyi mngag gzhug pa// bdag gis gnyis med bstod par bgyis// ta na'i ched du phyag rgya 'dis// mdzes ma 'di dag phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rigs lnga las byung 'di phul bas// rig pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin shog /pañtsa ku la bi dyā nirya ta yā mi/

man ngag bzhin du snyom zhugs mthar// lha dang mi yi bde ba ni// bsdus byas rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// bcu drug char yang mi phod pa'i// bde ba bla na med pas mchod// oṃ ma hā su kha badzra sa twa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ su ra te st+waṃ/ ga na'i ched du pho nya'i tshogs// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// 'dzin pa ci yang phyogs bcur 'phros// gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs kun// thams cad snying phug zhags pas bcings// lcags sgrog gis bsdams dril bus nyed// rlung gi gzhu la bskyon nas su// gshin rje'i btson bzhin mdun du khrid// sngags kyi mtha' ma che ge mo// mo ha ya= btags la bzlas/ /rta mchog de yi kha nas zhugs// lus brgyangs ngag mnan yid mnan pas// de yi lus ngag yid gsum po// dbang chen sku gsung thugs su bsgral// sngags mthar gnod par byed pa rnams// mā ra ya phaṭ btags pa brjod// dpal gyi rta skad thengs gsum 'tsher// lnga phung rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir// de yi phung po khams skye mched// dbang chen rigs drug skur bzhengs nas// rol pa'i bro brdung 'di mdzad do// dbyings nyid rdzogs pa'i sa gzhi la// bud dha khrag 'thung rol pa'i bro// gti mug gnas su 'joms pa ste// 'da' ka sku yi dam tshig go /me long 'od gsal sa gzhi la// rdo rje khrag 'thung rol pa'i bro// zhe sdang gnas su 'joms pa ste// 'da' ka thugs kyi dam tshig go /so sor rtog pa'i sa gzhi la// padma khrag 'thung rol pa'i bro// 'dod chags gnas su 'joms pa ste// sgra mtha' gsung gi dam tshig go /nan tan chen po'i sa gzhi la// karma khrag 'thung rol pa'i bro// phrag dog gnas su 'joms pa ste// 'phrin las 'da' ka'i dam tshig go /stong nyid rtogs pa'i sa gzhi la// dbang chen khrag 'thung rol pa'i bro// dug lnga gnas su 'joms pa ste// sku lnga lhun grub dam tshig go /dbyings phyug lnga yi sa gzhi la// ye shes lnga yi bro brdung la// dug lnga 'joms pa'i glu blangs shing*// sdug bsngal chu bo'i rgyun bskams nas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting bskams te// sku gsung thugs su rgyas btab pas// bde ba chen por rnam sbyar te// dmyal sogs me dpung gnas su bsad// 'di ni dpal gyi bro bo che// thos pa tsam gyis rtog pa 'byung*// brdungs ba tsam gyis thugs dam skong*//

zhes 'khrab stong nyid dbyings la bzhag /mtha' mar dge ba byang chub bsngo// de skad blo bzang dga' bo la// padma dkar pos sbyin pa yin// 'di 'dra'i sbyor sgrol chos yin zhes// sngags nag kun la slob pas na// legs par bshad pa 'dir byung tshig /mi zad rgyud sde'i grogs po yin/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
